description: This file implements concurrency debugging utilities, including tracking mutex contention times and logging stack traces when contention exceeds thresholds, enabled conditionally by SB_ENABLE_CONCURRENCY_DEBUG.

classes.name: ScopedMutexWaitTracker
classes.description: A RAII class that tracks mutex acquisition attempts and logs contention details if thresholds are exceeded.

methods.name: ScopedMutexWaitTracker::ScopedMutexWaitTracker
methods.description: Constructor that attempts to acquire a mutex and records start time if not immediately acquired.

methods.name: ScopedMutexWaitTracker::~ScopedMutexWaitTracker
methods.description: Destructor that calculates wait time, updates max contention, and logs details if contention is significant.
